./preprints/Hamiltonian-Fixed-Points-Below-the-Stable-Morse-Number-October-5-2026/build/sections/history.tex:2:Arnold's fixed-point questions ask how much of the critical-point theory of a small autonomous Hamiltonian persists for a general Hamiltonian path \cite{Arnold1986}.
